    Additivity of the pair functors #

    For a finite product Π i, N i of modules, h⁺ and h⁻ are computed componentwise (mem_plus_pi, mem_minus_pi), hence so are the numerators and denominators of the pair functors, and their dimensions add up (finrank_pnum_pi, finrank_pden_pi).

    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.finrank_of_components {k : Type u} [Field k] {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → Type u_2) [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (N i)] [(i : ι) → Module k (N i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional k (N i)] (P : Submodule k ((i : ι) → N i)) (Q : (i : ι) → Submodule k (N i)) (hPQ : ∀ (x : (i : ι) → N i), x ∈ P ↔ ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Q i) :
    Module.finrank k ↥P = ∑ i : ι, Module.finrank k ↥(Q i)

    A submodule of a product given componentwise has the sum of the dimensions.
